note: sh4der-pvr-suite14: suite 13's thirteen programs plus the heat haze street demo (passed FINAL by the owner, 2026-11-26), with the fields of the menu look B v7: menu_group, effects (main first), card, the By Effect rows (effect_headings) and the Not in the menu row. Card text: Scholar's final cards (owner approved). NOT RUN on a console.

tests.name: ao4
tests.what: AO side by side; clip guard; tile cut last. 110 s
tests.title: Room shading, four ways
tests.shows: corner shading: none, baked, ground, texture

card.what: The same room four times side by side, each with a different way of darkening the corners.
card.controls: Automatic run, about 110 seconds. A+B+X+Y goes back to the menu.
card.cost: Measured on one console: the bake at load takes 254 ms for scene A and 393 ms for scene B.

tests.name: ao-lamp
tests.what: lamp: sss shade, halo; slots in stage 3. ~35 s
tests.read: photo pages+graph; live: X compare, A near, dn inside
tests.title: Lamp with a lit shade
tests.shows: light through a thin shade, glow halo

card.what: A lamp whose shade lets light through its thin parts, with a glow round the lamp.
card.controls: Automatic run, about 35 seconds. Live: X compares, A goes near, down goes inside.
card.cost: Measured on one console in the lamp program's own loop: the glow round the lamp takes about 0.2 ms.

tests.name: hero1
tests.read: he and his shadow stay on screen; photo every page
tests.title: Space soldier on a street
tests.shows: running figure, his shadow, hangars, long street

card.what: A figure running down a long street with his shadow, hangars and hens beside the road.
card.controls: Automatic run, about 35 seconds. A+B+X+Y goes back to the menu.
card.cost: Measured on one console in an earlier build: about 19 ms a frame when idle.

tests.name: d1
tests.what: depth fade: glow cut by walls, soft right. ~70 s
tests.read: film it all; pages after. Left half steady from stage 3?
tests.title: Glow that meets a wall
tests.shows: a glow that fades where it meets a wall

card.what: A glow that fades where it meets a wall, instead of stopping on a hard line.
card.controls: Automatic run, about 70 seconds. A+B+X+Y goes back to the menu.
card.cost: Measured on one console in an earlier build of this test: the fade's depth map cost about 3.7 ms a frame.

tests.name: hens-eyes
tests.what: hens: rays vs collision sweep, cycles. ~50 s
tests.read: photo every page + graph; START = live: X mode, Y hens
tests.title: Hens that see the room
tests.shows: two ways to steer hens, and what each costs

card.what: Two ways to steer hens round a room, side by side, with what each one costs.
card.controls: Automatic run, about 50 seconds. START opens live: X changes mode, Y the hens.

tests.name: pvr-dma
tests.what: PVR-DMA download proof: VRAM to RAM. ~2 s
tests.read: PVR-DMA download proof: photo the page and the graph
tests.title: Copy video memory to RAM
tests.shows: a fast copy by the graphics chip, checked

card.what: A fast copy of picture memory into RAM by the graphics chip, checked against the original.
card.controls: Automatic, about 2 seconds, then the result pages. A+B+X+Y goes back to the menu.
card.cost: Measured on one console in an earlier copy test: about 25 MB/s for a polled copy.

tests.name: car-tech
tests.what: car map autorun: shadow, heat fly-by. ~56 s
tests.read: photo every page; 8 stages; stage 2 fly-by
tests.title: Car in a city by day
tests.shows: reflection, car shadow, corner shading, heat haze

effects.heading: ROAD CORNER SHADING
effects.text: Road corner shading, baked by the host tool

card.what: An automatic run down a city street by day, with the car's reflection, its shadow and corner shading.
card.controls: Automatic run, about 56 seconds. A+B+X+Y goes back to the menu.
card.cost: Earlier build of the street demo, measured on one console: 18 to 26 ms a frame.

tests.name: car-hills
tests.what: car hills autorun: shadow, heat fly-by. ~63 s
tests.read: photo every page; 9 stages; stage 4 fly-by
tests.title: Car on hills
tests.shows: car shadow on sloped ground, reflection

card.what: An automatic run with the car on a sloped road, showing its shadow on the slope and its reflection.
card.controls: Automatic run, about 63 seconds. A+B+X+Y goes back to the menu.
card.cost: Earlier build of the hills map, measured on one console: 53 to 57 frames a second.

tests.name: car-wet
tests.what: wet night road autorun. ~35 s + pages
tests.read: photo every page; reflection pool, grit, rain
tests.title: Car on a wet night road
tests.shows: rain, wet road, light pools, reflection, grit

card.what: An automatic run on a wet road at night: rain, the car in the wet road, lamp pools and grit.
card.controls: Automatic run, about 35 seconds. A+B+X+Y goes back to the menu.

tests.name: drive-map
tests.what: DRIVE the car: map. Live, you play
tests.read: B+Y hides the HUD, START brings it back; ABXY = menu
tests.title: Drive a car in a city
tests.shows: you drive: reflection, shadow, low camera

card.what: You drive the car down the city street, with its reflection and shadow on.
card.controls: You drive. B+Y hides the panel; START brings it back. A+B+X+Y goes back to the menu.
card.cost: Earlier build of the street demo, measured on one console: 18 to 26 ms a frame.

tests.name: drv-hills
tests.read: lights stay on slopes; B+Y hides HUD; ABXY = menu
tests.title: Drive a car on hills
tests.shows: you drive: slopes, lights that stay on the car

card.what: You drive the car on the hills. Light pools lie on the road as it slopes.
card.controls: You drive. B+Y hides the panel. A+B+X+Y goes back to the menu.
card.cost: Earlier build of the hills map, measured on one console: 53 to 57 frames a second.

tests.name: drv-wet
tests.what: DRIVE the wet night road. Live
tests.read: Y rain; B+Y hides HUD; ABXY = menu
tests.title: Drive a wet night road
tests.shows: you drive: rain, light pools, wet road

card.what: You drive on a wet night road, with rain, light pools and the wet road itself.
card.controls: You drive. Y makes rain. B+Y hides the panel. A+B+X+Y goes back to the menu.

tests.name: square
tests.what: Walled square, AO on. Y+A hides the HUD
tests.read: walls darken at the foot; START, VIEW, AO row off compares
tests.title: Walled town square
tests.shows: AO, sun shadows, hens, Y+A hides HUD

card.what: A walled square with stalls, a fountain and hens, with baked corner shading and sun shadows.
card.controls: Walk it. Y+A hides the panel. START, VIEW and the AO row compare the corners.

tests.name: heat-haze
tests.what: Heat haze hexagons on a hill street. Live
tests.read: X heat off/light/strong, A restart, B+X fly-by, START tech
tests.title: Heat haze on a hot road
tests.shows: hot air shimmers over the road ahead

card.what: A shimmer of hot air over the road ahead, drawn over the picture of the road.
card.controls: X steps the heat: off, light, strong. It starts on.

not_in_menu.subtitle: Not a demo: nothing to run.
not_in_menu.intro: These effects are in the library, but this menu has no demo for them. Each line says where else the effect is shown.
